resources.string: Warden blocks the domains on the lists you switch on. Each list downloads from its publisher and refreshes weekly on Wi-Fi. Tap a list\'s status to update it now.
No account, no analytics, no cloud. Warden watches where your apps connect, on this phone, and never decrypts what they send.
